name: Bama Bound Trend
blurb: One photo in: you lift the red I'M BAMA BOUND sign over your head, jump and cheer like you just got in.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep the person exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone, build and outfit the whole time. Vertical 9:16 phone video on a wide green grass field under a bright blue sky, tall pine trees along the edge, sunny midday light, natural handheld shake. (1) The main character stands in the grass smiling, holding a bright red sign with big bold white letters that read I'M BAMA BOUND, nothing else printed on it. (2) They lift the sign high over their head with both arms straight and grin at the camera. (3) They bounce, jump twice and cheer like they just got the acceptance letter with a full ride, hair flying. (4) Last beat: they hold the sign up again and pose, still laughing. Their face stays clearly visible whenever they face the camera. The sign text stays readable and spelled exactly I'M BAMA BOUND. Audio: an upbeat celebratory hip-hop beat, happy screams of "I got in!". No logos, no mascots, no other text, no captions, no watermark.

(2) The main character from the photo, in the middle, pulls up a bright red sign with big bold white letters that read I'M BAMA BOUND, nothing else printed on it, and holds it high over their head. (3) Everyone screams, jumps up and down and throws their arms in the air around them, hugging and cheering like they just got in. prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep the person exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone, build and outfit the whole time. Vertical 9:16 phone video in a warm-lit living room at night, a wall lamp glowing behind, handheld shake. (1) The main character holds a bright red sign at chest height that reads I'M BAMA BOUND in big bold white letters, nothing else printed on it, and looks down at it in disbelief. (2) Slowly a huge grin spreads across their face; they raise the sign straight up over their head with both arms. (3) They jump up from the couch, pump the sign in the air and cheer like they just found out they got in with a full ride. (4) Last beat: they point at the sign and nod at the camera. The sign text stays readable and spelled exactly I'M BAMA BOUND. Audio: an upbeat celebratory hip-hop beat, them shouting "I got in!". No logos, no mascots, no other text, no captions, no watermark.
